scope: Published staging with separate worker and production resource budgets; new cache master off. Local candidate fixes only navigation employee counts.

httpMethod.transport: urllib HTTPS HTTP/1.1, new connection per request, gzip requested, no browser/network emulation
httpMethod.profile: Dedicated staging administrator, normal login and logout.
httpMethod.sampling: One excluded initial read per route, 100 measured per route; no forced cache/database eviction. Legacy caches have a 60-second TTL.
httpMethod.guard: One 24-second pause after five steal samples >=50%; all 600 observations retained. Stop on any observed OOM kill.
httpMethod.scope: Client HTTP timings cover the public HTTPS deployment. Server pool/log aggregates include navigation before the synthetic cohort, health checks and other concurrent traffic; no exact per-request server correlation is claimed.
httpMethod.compression: Gzip requested. Larger responses compressed; the small navigation-count JSON stays below the 1024-byte compression threshold.

localCorrection.description: Count distinct employees from all successful sync histories, subtract current links and ignored employees; do not fetch full monthly/day-allocation integration data.
localCorrection.timingLimit: Only the employee-count subroutine, in a serialized read-only transaction on a shared host; not the full badge HTTP response and not an end-to-end latency acceptance.

fullBackend.database: Migrated disposable PostgreSQL 16, isolated loopback port; four test-file workers.

includes: Changes to links and ignored employees

validation.initialFullSuiteAttempt: Eight failures with a nonexistent dummy database; rerun with migrated isolated PostgreSQL passed without application fixes for those failures.

limitations: One administrator, one selected project/group, sequential light load. No production, viewer/division, first-load p95 or browser-content acceptance.
CPU steal still high; provider CPU-credit/host state not known. No causal latency comparison against earlier cohorts with differing flags, load or topology.
Navigation initial peaks remain separate from the warmed/TTL-mixed cohort: dashboard 6559.34 ms and pendency count 6596.15 ms, each one observation.
Point summary still has costly recomputations. Cache-only-response trial on this published topology and stable-CPU profiling remain pending.
Worker health completed count includes successful empty queue scans, not just JobRun records.
No source, flags, limits, images or existing services were changed by this assessment; a new candidate module was evaluated in memory in a one-off CLI process using a read-only transaction.
Backups, historical records and retention application untouched.
